<STRUCT_0001>
If the quotient <MATH_0001> is representable by <MATH_0002> (either a scheme or an algebraic
space over <MATH_0003>), then it comes equipped with a canonical structure morphism
<MATH_0004> as we've seen above.

<STRUCT_0002><STRUCT_0003>

of finite presentation and surjective, and <MATH_0007>.

In the situation of Definition <REF_0001>.

and a morphism <MATH_0003> such that
<STRUCT_0001>
